fact: The pilot registration system in Antananarivo and Toamasina registered over 3,000 newborns and issued birth certificate copies with a unique identification number, and a decree on the attribution and management of the UIN was adopted in April 2023, while the share of the population with a UIN credential stood at 0.01 percent.
title: Implementation Status & Results Report: Digital Governance and Identification Management System Project - PRODIGY (P169413)
